brief: Lean starving undead ice wolf, long low horizontal body, four visibly separate wiry legs, hooked angular muzzle and one exposed ivory lower jaw, torn broad slate pelt plates, short icy spine crest, long thin ragged tail. Blue soul light eyes, stalking grounded crouch. Clearly canine, not mammoth or dragon, no tusks, armor, wings or antlers. One broad funerary cloth strip tied around foreleg. Non-gory.
